result: No actionable integration defect found in the declared bounded source-only mode.
method: Read-only source review of the new stream, preparation/transport/UI integration and independent tests; compared data flow with the sealed concrete-provider/descriptor finding. No new tests were run by this reviewer.

checks.evidence: CPRSourceEventRenderer.prepare is still called first. It replays verified source/report data, validates the attached media metadata/hash and exact bounded WAV layout, and obtains the existing no-fade/no-warp/no-loop complete zero-origin source plan. The new mode requires stereo and does not bypass those gates.

The new stream uses source plan rate and period1/rate; project.sampleRate does not silently resample it. This is an explicitly supplied reconstruction builder context. Concrete PAudioSegment inputs are stored start, separately rounded start+length end, and source offset. The public app entry supplies only the verified zero-origin placement; synthetic wider descriptors do not expand CPR interpretation.

Initializer bounds sample rate, descriptor order/nonoverlap, total sample storage, quantized extent and source endpoint. C quantization rejects invalid floating environment/nonfinite/subnormal coordinates and conversion overflow. Samples and post-gain values must be finite normal or permitted zero; unsupported values reject before scheduling.

Each block starts fully zeroed. Absolute request start/end/current cursor are passed to the native-derived C planner. SKIP advances only the local segment index; successful reads use returned relative output offset, source seek and count. The end-equal segment remains until a later planner skip. Cursor/index publish after the complete block succeeds, so failed production does not commit progress.

Preparation decodes PCM24 at unity for this mode. Each copied source interval then calls rb_cpr_event_gain_f32 exactly once per channel with the saved Float32 event gain. The player and mixer remain unity. Rebase track pan/gain/automation are not silently applied to the selected unresolved native event.

Native timeline mode exits preparation before the rate-converted branch and uses a distinct nativeTimelineStream. It does not pass through the audition FIFO, rate converter or callback alternating correction. Immutable memory reads always return the full requested count; native transient read retry is retained in the value helper and tested independently, not falsely simulated by this memory backend.

Transport creates one player for either stream kind, constructs a fresh cursor at each clamped application seek, and uses the existing serialized producer queue. Queue cancellation precedes player stop and acts as a scheduling barrier. Completion callbacks return before dispatching work; generation checks prevent stale completion from ending a replacement run. Four-buffer host queuing and UI time-to-frame rounding remain Rebase policies.

StudioSession resumes and seeks by configuring the source event again, checking preserved project/root state and fresh source/media proof. Failed configuration clears audition state. Edits/explicit exit preserve the existing transition to project mode. UI labels this as source event audition, describes the native-derived reader, and states that general CPR placement/project processing remain unresolved.

PreparedProject storage gains one internal optional stream only. Whole-project render/play/export admission still requires resolved audio events. No playable clip, placement reinterpretation, source identity or historical interpretation profile is created by audition.

scope: Integer-indexed synthetic direct-read oracle at8192Hz covers starts, gaps, offsets, touching segments, multiple partitions, seeks and exact power-of-two gains.

Real pinned LoFi CPR plus independently authored PCM24 fixture checks every output sample bit using integer sign/mantissa construction, avoiding the production decoder/planner as expected-output oracle.

Stale media/Original.cpr/report rejection, source/package preservation, whole-project barriers, invalid descriptors, cursor transactionality and a source-derived nonzero CPR negative control are present.
independent_test_design_review.observed_log_result: core-tests-first.log reports248tests/38suites passed. Targeted timeline-tests-second.log reports10tests/2suites passed. These are retained application test results, not proprietary-runtime comparisons.

additional_native_review: APP014/timeline-instruction-verification.json independently verifies concrete provider QI/store/registration and three getters as part of nine original intervals. This arrived after the provider cold seal and is an additive review; no sealed native file was altered.
limitations: General nonzero CPR start/offset projection remains gated because containing-context start units differ from own-clip delta units, and builder rate/extra shift/overlap context require additional source binding.
No live Cubase object graph, device output, project mixer/routing, arbitrary overlap, concurrent native list mutation, non-memory backend or target runtime conformance was tested.
This review did not repeat the peer's entire numerical instruction/oracle audit, the full suite, GUI checks or hardware playback.
Application scheduling and immutable full-read backend are deliberate implementation choices around the reconstructed bounded reader operations.
